title: Hearty Roasted Syrian Chicken Wings Kebabs
description: A crispy and cozy Syrian dish featuring roasted chicken wings, perfect for a cold evening. This recipe is egg-free and friendly for various diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken wings onto skewers, leaving a small space between each wing.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 30 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the chicken wings are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the roasted chicken wings kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
